a.speaker: tommy_burnt
a.text: Cassie. You came to the party.

c.speaker: tommy_burnt
c.text: I'm the part of him you kept. Somebody had to. You burned the rest of the cast getting here.

d.speaker: tommy_burnt
d.text: Twenty-four. Nineteen. Thirty-one. You were never this good at math.

e.speaker: tommy_burnt
e.text: Let's do the take properly this time. You in the car. Me holding the extinguisher.
